title: 曲線縁石と側溝
description: 恒久的な道路縁石と浅い側溝を一体化した90度コーナー部材。 ゲーム・可視化向け。製造・構造設計・3Dプリント用途は未検証。
descriptionEn: A permanent 90-degree precast curb corner with integral shallow gutter; not a portable access ramp. For games and visualization; not validated for manufacture, structural engineering or 3D printing.
author: Xenoah
uv: Per-component primitive or automatically unwrapped UVs. Overlapping between components; not a packed unique lightmap atlas. Solid-color PBR materials; no external textures. STL has no colors or UVs.
